lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately four discernible horizontal rows. The mid-lateral row displays the largest centroids with increasing inter-blob distance moving posteriorly. High-density clustering is observed in the region immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit and superior to the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher luminance intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a lattice-like grid across the mid-flank where high-intensity blobs serve as intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal gradient is visible along the upper third of the flank, consisting of a high-luminance linear feature with a distinct shadow immediately ventral, extending from the gill region toward the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a low-density distribution of high-luminance circular blobs, primarily concentrated on the anterior and basal regions of the fin surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A morphological irregularity consisting of a concave missing segment is visible on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin near the apex.
other_distinctive_markers: A group of elongated, low-luminance objects is clustered beneath the pectoral fin and ventral surface, showing distinct movement-blur relative to the primary subject.
